// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-CHILD-RELATION
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

// The EVENT is ADULT_READABLE, so reading it is allowed — but reaching its
// appointments through it is the whole point of the relation rule: an include
// of a stricter model must fail even when the model at the top of the query is
// permitted. `slots` is a child relation because MeetingSlot is not an adult
// target, which the gate derives from the schema rather than from a list — so
// this refusal was already true the moment the model was classified, and this
// fixture is what proves it fires rather than asserting that it would.
export async function eveningWithBookings(schoolId: string) {
  return db.meetingEvent.findMany({
    where: { schoolId },
    select: { id: true, title: true, slots: { select: { startsAt: true, bookedAt: true } } },
  });
}
